title: Shopping starts with AI; our store must be agent-ready as PC volumes fall
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); HP launched an agentic web platform; TikTok and Newegg added agent or one-click checkout; Amex set agent-purchase rules. Q3 PC shipments fell 22.4% (Gartner), 21% (Omdia).

points.headline: Competitors and retailers are rebuilding shopping around AI agents
points.detail: HP launched Experience AI; TikTok added a conversational agent with one-click checkout; Newegg integrated Google UCP checkout. We should benchmark our discovery and checkout against these.

points.headline: AI discovery is mainstream, but trust and bot defenses gate agent buying
points.detail: NIQ: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery. Anti-bot defenses block shopping agents, and Amex now sets rules for authorized agent purchases. We should make our store readable and safe for agents.

points.headline: PC shipments are down more than 20% in Q3 as component costs rise
points.detail: Gartner reports a 22.4% fall and Omdia 21%, with component costs lifting prices. We should plan pricing, promotions and stock for a smaller, costlier PC market.

points.headline: Marketplace sales events pull electronics demand forward
points.detail: Prime Big Deal Days drove $9.86B in US online sales, with electronics up 85% on the September daily average. We should line up PC promotions and inventory for early-season events.
